decision_rationale: This is a new model paper on regulatory DNA, but the candidate model is sequence-only and does not describe natural-language text or text-conditioned bio modeling. The abstract and methods show a DNA language model trained on cCREs with motif-discovery regularization, which fits biological-token modeling rather than a text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: “short-context masked DNA language model,” “pretrained on the ENCODE consortium's official list of candidate cis-regulatory elements,” and “sequence-only self-supervision”
